fields.mechanism: Cartridge valve design that allows the element to be isolated from the circuit flow for maintenance.
fields.intervention: Integrate a dual-port cartridge with a bypass valve into the 50 mm line so the filter element can be swapped while the loop remains pressurized, preventing the need to drain the system.
fields.expected_effect: The filter cartridge will capture 90 percent of fine particulate, prevent the 15 percent loss of heat rejection over 90 days, and allow replacement without draining the coolant loop.
fields.falsification_test: Conduct a 90-day continuous run in a closed loop; isolate the cartridge and replace the element; if the loop requires draining or pressure is lost, the mechanism fails.
